mission: Package verified Buddy capabilities into portable, AI-readable capability bundles that users can select, install, sandbox, benchmark, and manage.

user_selection.selection_rule: Users select capabilities rather than selecting opaque model bundles.

bootcamp.promotion: A package is not considered installed/ready until its required checks pass.
bootcamp.failure: Failed packages remain isolated and produce a recovery record; they do not break Buddy or unrelated packages.

marketplace.pricing: Support free/open packages and paid packages with explicit licensing and pricing metadata.
marketplace.purchase_guard: No autonomous purchase or billing without explicit user authorization.
marketplace.quality: Publish benchmark scores, evidence level, version, dependencies, limitations, and known failures with every package.

knowledge_policy: Prefer lawful open, public-domain, licensed, or user-authorized knowledge. Package capabilities and structured knowledge rather than indiscriminately copying protected corpora.
